_comment: Ultra-HD 16-channel 4x4 array (250 um pitch) recorded on an Intan RHS2000.
The channel-to-position map is carried by the 'Grid (UltraHD 4x4)' preset.
Select the .rhs recording in Tab 1, then 'Load Config'. sampling_rate is the file's native
rate; 'decimate' (editable next to it in Tab 1) makes the loader deliver
20 kHz / 5 = 4 kHz, matching the amplifier's 500 Hz upper bandwidth. Also
Tab 2 per-grid settings to match the amplifier: low-pass 500 Hz, notch 60 Hz
